questions: Does your tremor mostly happen when you are resting your hands in your lap, or when you try to hold them up or use them for a task?
Do you notice the tremor when your hands are completely relaxed at your sides?
When you pour yourself a drink or bring a cup to your mouth, does your shaking get worse?
Did you first notice this tremor when you were young, before age 25, or did it start later in life?
Does the tremor also affect your head or voice, or is it mainly in your hands?
Do both your head and voice shake, or is it mainly your head?
Is your voice shaky all the time, or only when you are speaking?
Do both hands shake equally, or is one hand worse than the other?
Do you have a family member - parent, grandparent, or sibling - who also has shaky hands or head?
Does your voice tremor happen only when you speak, or also when you hum or sing a note?
